data.description: When killed, a star archon explodes in a blinding flash of energy that deals 50 points of damage (half fire, half holy damage) to anything within 100 feet (Reflex DC %1 half).  The slain archon reincarnates 1d4 rounds later as an advanced shield archon.|StarArchonExplosiveRebirthDC
